card.name: Item numbers in numbered lists
card.fires_on: A digit (or the closing bracket after it) that numbers an item in an inline list, often right after a colon such as 'contraindicated in:' or after a previous item.

modes.label: First item after colon
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a list after 'contraindicated in:' or 'patients:'.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Pindolol tablets are contraindicated in: <<1>>) bronchial asthma; 2

modes.description: A later list number such as 3, 5 or 8 inside a running sentence of numbered items.
